Storefront Audits: Continuously audit purchasing channels and storefronts to guarantee seamless purchasing mechanics and high-converting landing experiences. Marketing & Strategic Alignment (The Commercial Lead) Cross-Functional Interface: Act as the primary Commercial POC (Point of Contact) interfacing with the Marketing teams, translating revenue targets into clear promotional briefs, campaign timelines, and ad alignment. ROI & ROAS Management: Monitor campaign ROI (Return on Investment) and ROAS (Return on Ad Spend), providing strategic guidance and actionable feedback to Marketing to optimize ad spend and campaign timing. Price-Tier Management: Manage price-tier rollouts and dynamic upsell pathways throughout the customer funnel to encourage attendees to purchase beyond the entry ticket. Process Improvements: Self-identify commercial bottlenecks and operational deficiencies, taking the initiative to implement scalable process improvements across departments. GTM & Commercial Leadership: Proven track record in managing GTM (Go-To-Market) campaign delivery, digital sales funnels, and D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) acquisition metrics, including: CR (Conversion Rates) AOV (Average Order Value) ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) LTV (Lifetime Value) E-Commerce & Digital Systems: Deep familiarity with e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify), ticketing backoffices, and digital analytics tools (e.g., GA4 - Google Analytics 4, Meta Business Suite). Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to direct cross-functional efforts between creative/marketing teams, commercial leads, and external partners. Technical & Analytical Proficiency: Advanced skills in Excel / Google Sheets (sales modeling, tracking dashboards, forecasting) and PowerPoint / Google Slides (commercial briefs, campaign performance decks). Project Management: Advanced proficiency in structured project management tools (Monday.com or similar) and cross-team communication tools (Slack). Commercial Creativity: Ability to analyze products or events and craft compelling positioning strategies that generate active fan desire and purchasing intent. Problem-Solving & Agility: Highly organized with exceptional planning skills, capable of making fast, effective decisions in high-pressure, fast-paced environments. Commercial Leader: You are a commercial leader, connecting creative marketing ideas with concrete, repeatable revenue targets. Growth Mindset: You possess a strong growth mindset, constantly looking for creative product hooks, upsell triggers, and CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) opportunities to maximize fan lifetime value. Framework-Oriented: Highly structured and framework-oriented, you take pride in establishing standardized, scalable GTM (Go-To-Market) playbooks that work across multiple ecosystems.
